description: The file defines utility functions related to handling 'Form' objects within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes methods for generating XML tokens, structuring form fields, date formatting, and converting concepts and drugs into string representations suitable for HL7 integration.

classes.name: FormUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for form processing, XML token generation, date formatting, and conversion of concepts and drugs into HL7-compatible string representations.

methods.name: getXmlToken
methods.description: Converts a string into a valid XML token (tag name), handling invalid characters and ensuring it starts with a valid letter.

methods.name: getNewTag
methods.description: Generates a new, unique XML tag name from a string, avoiding duplicates by appending an index if necessary.

methods.name: getFormStructure
methods.description: Returns a sorted, hierarchical map of FormFields representing the structure of a given Form.

methods.name: dateToString
methods.description: Overloaded method formatting the current date or a provided Date object into an ISO 8601 string.

methods.name: getFormUriWithoutExtension
methods.description: Creates a string identifier for a Form based on its id, version, and build.

methods.name: conceptToString
methods.description: Converts a Concept to a string suitable for HL7 messages, using concept ID and localized name.

methods.name: conceptToString
methods.description: Converts a Concept and its specific name to a string for HL7, including concept ID and name.

methods.name: drugToString
methods.description: Converts a Drug object into an HL7-compatible string with drug ID and name.
